name: Banco Central do Brasil SGS time series API
summary: Thousands of Brazilian economic and financial time series (Selic, inflation, FX, credit, activity) from the central bank SGS, by series code as JSON or CSV.
description: The Sistema Gerenciador de Séries Temporais (SGS) holds interest rates, price indices, exchange rates, monetary aggregates, credit and activity indicators. The API at api.bcb.gov.br returns a series by numeric code, either the full range, a date window or the last N observations, in JSON or CSV.

endpoints.summary: Observations for a series (date window with dataInicial and dataFinal)

license.name: Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL), as listed for the BCB open-data portal catalogue

agent_notes: Docs are in Portuguese. Dates are dd/mm/yyyy and values are strings ('valor'), with a decimal point in JSON and a comma in CSV. Series 11 is the daily Selic rate (% per day) and 432 the Selic target; codes come from the SGS site. A daily series without dataInicial is rejected, and a daily window is limited to 10 years.
caveats: Series 432 'ultimos' returned entries dated December 2026 on 2026-11-11 (future dates), so check the dates of the target series before treating them as observed.
The /dados/ultimos/{n} path needs the 'dados' segment; /ultimos/1 alone returned 404.
The ODbL statement was read from the portal catalogue, not from the SGS service itself.

verification.notes: Exact example request executed without a key.
